issue_request: FHIR-17589 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification STU3 FHIR Infrastructure change request titled "Drop OperationOutcome.issue.location". Its final resolution was to mark OperationOutcome.issue.location as deprecated and rework the documentation about the use of the element because issue.expression replaced it as the format-independent mechanism.
initial_application: The Jira comment points to svn revision 14528, represented in git by e8c22a3727455852300b359fe317824ad3ae2224. That commit marked the OperationOutcome.issue.location source row as deprecated, changed its short/definition/comment to point to issue.expression, and rewrote the OperationOutcome notes from location-element guidance toward expression-based issue-location reporting. Later source refactors preserved that state in the current StructureDefinition XML.
additional_context: The linked July 2018 Zulip thread supports the same interpretation: location was limited XPath, while expression was intended to become a syntax-independent single location mechanism. OperationOutcome is active in source/fhir.ini. Later same-family work, including FHIR-18508 and already-published AutoFHIR audits for FHIR-18505 and FHIR-18508, clarified expression wording and did not reverse the deprecation decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/operationoutcome/structuredefinition-OperationOutcome.xml marks OperationOutcome.issue.location as deprecated with a standards-status reason saying issue.expression replaces it, and source/operationoutcome/operationoutcome-notes.xml is titled "Using the Expression" and directs applications to use expression consistently for locations.
